rust_summary: `native_entities_in(dimension, min, max)`: the ids of the entities of any loaded level inside a box.
doc_summary: `native_entities_in(dimension, min, max)` gives the ids of the entities of the loaded level `dimension` inside the box from `min` to `max` (both corners included), players the hub holds included; empty for a level not loaded and on a client. It walks every entity of the level, so call it for a few boxes, not every tick. Bundles need "hooks": @API:entities_in@.
